scripts.translation:
[混沌]
这在魔法大赛中会很有用。
走吧，艾莉丝~！
比赛马上就要开始了~！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Yes~! Go {0}~
Kafra, wish us luck~!
Do your best {1}.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
好~！加油，{0}~
卡普拉，祝我们好运~！
{1}，加油哦。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Are you okay?
Where are all these punks coming from anyways?
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
你没事吧？
这些混混到底是从哪里冒出来的？

scripts.text:
[Magic Academy Student]
Thanks for helping me.
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[魔法学院学生]
谢谢你帮了我。
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
I am Fenris Fenrir.
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
我是芬里斯·芬里尔。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Thank {0}.
It would have been much worse if {1} hadn't shown up.
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
应该谢谢{0}。
要不是{1}出现，情况可能会糟得多。

scripts.text:
[Magic Academy Student]
Thank you so much {0}.
You saved me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法学院学生]
非常感谢你，{0}。
你救了我。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
You don't meet many people like {0} these days.
You're a good person.
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
现在很少见到像{0}这样的人了。
你是个好人。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
I was on the way to register for the Geffen Magic Tournament with Loki.
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
我正和洛基一起去吉芬魔法大赛报名。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
I have a feeling that you will register too {0}.
I hope to meet you in the finals of the Tournament.
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
我感觉你也会报名，{0}。
希望能在大赛决赛见到你。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
Oh yeah?
{0} is going to register?
That's interesting.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
哦？
{0}也要报名？
有意思。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
I have a spare magic buff scroll.
I will give it to you as a present.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
我有一张多余的魔法增益卷轴。
送给你当礼物吧。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
I doubt that you can beat Fenrir at the Tournament.
Her fighting prowess is unmatched.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
我不认为你能在大赛中打败芬里尔。
她的战斗力无人能及。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
Fenrir, it's time to register.
Let's hurry.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
芬里尔，该去报名了。
我们快走吧。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Yes~! I almost forgot.
It was nice meeting you {0}~!
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
好~！我差点忘了。
很高兴认识你，{0}~！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
I hope to meet you in combat soon.
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
希望很快能在赛场上和你交手。

scripts.text:
[Geffen Resident]
My monthly salary...
What am I gonna do?
I have to eat...
scripts.translation:
[吉芬居民]
我的月薪...
我该怎么办？
我得吃饭啊...

scripts.text:
[Geffen Resident]
You're not a thief are you?
I don't know what to do about my zeny being stolen.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬居民]
你不会是小偷吧？
我的Zeny被偷了，我都不知道该怎么办了。

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
Woo, yeah, what a day~
It seems like all these thieves in Geffen are rich.
They may be good at stealing but they're easy to steal from too.
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
哇，今天可真不错~
吉芬这些小偷还挺有钱的。
他们虽然很会偷东西，可要从他们身上偷东西，也容易得很。

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
Hey, why are you crying?
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
嘿，你为什么在哭？
发生什么事了？

scripts.text: You tell Lydia about the shoplifters.
scripts.translation: 你把那些商店窃贼的事告诉了莉迪亚。

scripts.text:
[Geffen Resident]
What am I going to do?
*sobbing*
scripts.translation:
[吉芬居民]
我该怎么办？
*抽泣*

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
(I stole this envelope from one of those thug-looking guys)
....
How much zeny was stolen from you?
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
（这个信封是我从一个看起来像恶棍的家伙身上偷来的。）
...
你被偷了多少Zeny？

scripts.text:
[Geffen Resident]
1,000,000 zeny!
It's everything that I had.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬居民]
1,000,000 Zeny！
那是我的全部积蓄。

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
Whoa! That's the same amount as what's in this envelope that I stole from that shoplifter.
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
哇！正好跟我从那个商店窃贼身上偷来的信封里的钱一样多。

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
Maybe this is what you are looking for?
Check it out!
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
也许这就是你在找的东西？
看看这个！

scripts.text:
[Geffen Resident]
Let me see...
Wait, this has to be my zeny!
Thank you very much for finding it!
scripts.translation:
[吉芬居民]
让我看看...
等等，这一定是我的Zeny！
非常感谢你帮我找到它！

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
Well... Um, that is...
I didn't say I was gonna give it back to you...
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
呃...那个...
我可没说要把钱还给你...

scripts.text:
[Geffen Resident]
Thank you very much!!
I will never forget your kindness~!
I'm putting it in the bank right now!
Have a good day~!!! Zap~!!
scripts.translation:
[吉芬居民]
太感谢了！！
我永远不会忘记你的恩情~！
我这就去银行把钱存起来！
祝你今天愉快~！！！嗖~！！

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
......
I guess... I did a good thing...?
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
...
我这算是...做了件好事...？

scripts.text: You tell Lydia about your stolen zeny.
scripts.translation: 你把自己的Zeny被偷的事告诉了莉迪亚。

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
So, are you asking me for more zeny?
Zeny doesn't grow on trees you know!
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
所以，你还想让我给你更多Zeny？
Zeny可不会从天上掉下来！

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
I mean it is hers so...
I'll just consider it a donation to the Geffen Magic Tournament.
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
毕竟，那本来就是她的钱嘛...
就当我为吉芬魔法大赛捐款了。

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
Well, I can't give away any Tournament participants any zeny...
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
不过，我可不能给大赛参赛者送钱...

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
I stole this magic scroll from another thief, so don't worry about taking it.
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
这张魔法卷轴是我从另一个盗贼那里偷来的，所以你就放心拿去吧。

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
I need to get to the Geffen Magic Tournament.
Gotta go!
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
我得赶去吉芬魔法大赛了。
走了！
